name: Can garage entry accessibility upgrades increase my home's value?

mainEntity.name: Can garage entry accessibility upgrades increase my home's value?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, garage entry accessibility upgrades can potentially increase your home's value and broaden its appeal. Features like automatic door openers, ramps, and wider doorways make a home more functional and attractive to a wider range of potential buyers, including those with mobility needs or those planning for future accessibility. These improvements demonstrate a well-maintained and thoughtfully upgraded property, often seen as a valuable asset.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, upgrades can increase home value by enhancing functionality and appealing to a broader market, including those with accessibility needs.
